send_notification.implementation:
import smtplib from email.mime.text import MimeText from email.mime.multipart import MimeMultipart from datetime import datetime, timezone def send_sync_notification(notification_type: str, sync_request: dict, gmail_credentials: dict, additional_data: dict = None) -> dict: try: # Load email template template = get_email_template(notification_type) # Prepare template variables template_vars = prepare_template_variables(sync_request, additional_data) # Render email content subject = template['subject_template'].format(**template_vars) html_body = template['html_template'].format(**template_vars) text_body = template.get('text_template', '').format(**template_vars) # Create message msg = MimeMultipart('alternative') msg['From'] = gmail_credentials['from_address'] msg['To'] = gmail_credentials['to_address'] msg['Subject'] = subject # Add body parts if text_body: text_part = MimeText(text_body, 'plain') msg.attach(text_part) html_part = MimeText(html_body, 'html') msg.attach(html_part) # Send email with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.gmail.com', 587) as server: server.starttls() server.login(gmail_credentials['username'], gmail_credentials['password']) server.send_message(msg) return { 'success': True, 'message_id': f"willow_sync_{sync_request['sync_id']}_{notification_type}", 'sent_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() } except Exception as e: return { 'success': False, 'error': str(e), 'notification_type': notification_type, 'sync_id': sync_request.get('sync_id', 'unknown') } def prepare_template_variables(sync_request: dict, additional_data: dict = None) -> dict: # Base variables from sync request variables = { 'sync_id': sync_request.get('sync_id', ''), 'property_address': sync_request.get('property_address', ''), 'client_name': sync_request.get('client_name', ''), 'partner_agent': sync_request.get('partner_agent', ''), 'sandbox_cma_url': sync_request.get('sandbox_cma_url', ''), 'priority': sync_request.get('priority', 'normal'), 'priority_class': 'urgent' if sync_request.get('priority') == 'urgent' else 'normal', 'created_at': format_datetime(sync_request.get('created_at', '')), 'estimated_completion': format_datetime(sync_request.get('estimated_completion', '')) } # Processing notes section notes = sync_request.get('processing_notes', '') if notes: variables['processing_notes_section'] = f'''
Notes: {notes}
''' variables['processing_notes'] = f'Notes: {notes}' else: variables['processing_notes_section'] = '' variables['processing_notes'] = '' # Add additional data if provided if additional_data: variables.update(additional_data) return variables
error_handling: SMTP connection failure → Log error and queue for retry
Template rendering error → Send plain text fallback
